dedupe_keys.name: vindbrukskollen onshore wind turbines sweden 5 812 erected turbines with height rotor power make and owner

description: Vindbrukskollen is the Swedish national map service for planned and existing wind turbines; this record covers its layer of onshore turbines. Contents: point features per turbine. The erected-turbines layer of the ArcGIS service returned 5,812 features on 29 September 2026 (253 further points are dismantled turbines), with fields for turbine id, project area id and name, status, application type, erected year, total height, hub height, rotor diameter, maximum power, calculated production, make, model, owner organisation number and name, placement, municipality and county. Producer: the county administrative boards (contact: the environmental protection unit), with the database updated continuously by users through the Vindlov web service. Coverage: Sweden onshore; a separate layer covers offshore wind. Format and access: WMS updated daily and ATOM downloads in shape and geopackage formats, plus an ArcGIS REST service; free. Licence: Creative Commons CC0 1.0, no access restriction (catalogue entry). Caveats: entries are user-maintained; the OpenStreetMap wiki import page reports checked turbines sitting within about 10 metres of their real position, but that is a volunteer check, not an official accuracy figure. Simulation uses: siting wind generation in power system capacity and hazard exposure models. Related records: none identified.
